newsitem.title: USA: Sprint wins $65 million Florida contract.
newsitem.headline: Sprint wins $65 million Florida contract.

text.p: Sprint Corp. said Monday the Florida Department of Corrections awarded the company a contract valued at up to $65 million to provide long distance telephone service for inmates at 53 correctional facilities throughout the state.
The contract includes a base of three years' service, with two one-year renewal options, the telecommunications company said.

Sprint also said it formed an agreement with InVision Telecom, a unit of Communications Central Inc., calling for the two companies to work together regularly in marketing communications services to state, local and private corrections facilities.
